question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in readiness feature as a supported long-term public contract across Gateway configuration, RPC, CLI, and the Plugin SDK?
rationale: The implementation appears intentionally broad and compatibility-aware, but neither automated review nor local code inspection can decide whether these new public APIs and their future deprecation/support obligations fit the product direction.

options.title: Accept the full readiness contract
options.body: Approve the opt-in configuration, `ready` RPC/CLI, and Plugin SDK criterion registration as supported public interfaces, subject to normal final-head merge checks.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Keep the canonical core readiness result but defer the Plugin SDK registration API or selected criteria until owners define a smaller permanent surface.

options.title: Pause for RFC decision
options.body: Hold this PR until the related readiness RFC receives an explicit maintainer decision on the public contract and ownership model.

recommendation.title: Accept the full readiness contract
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in configuration, `ready` RPC/CLI, and Plugin SDK criterion registration as supported public interfaces, subject to normal final-head merge checks.
